name: @veg/hyphaeon-mcp
description: MCP server for HyphAeon: one hyphaeon_analyze tool that runs the whole report in-process (site selection, omnibus, epistasis + sectors, attribution, artifact filter, digital DMS, and phenotype association when a trait is given), the per-pillar tools and MEME concordance, over stdio or streamable HTTP. No Python and no HyPhy at runtime; a tree is optional everywhere (TN93 distances otherwise).
